chapter.ch01.title: Chapter 1: The Boy Who Wanted to Be Scolded
ui.gameover.title: The assembly fell silent
ui.miss.label: Miss
evidence.ledger_theft.name: Theft Ledger
evidence.ledger_theft.desc: Dates and items of 14 thefts across 5 shops. All everyday goods: stationery, sweets, batteries. Nothing worth reselling.
evidence.vhs_tape.name: Security VHS
evidence.vhs_tape.desc: Tape from the photo studio's loaned camera. At the time of the theft, someone who should have been at cram school appears.
evidence.notebook_page.name: Wataru's Notebook
evidence.notebook_page.desc: A notebook left under the waiting chair. A scrawl reads: 'I want this to end.'
evidence.shop_receipt.name: Purchase Slips
evidence.shop_receipt.desc: Sales slips from Shinomiya Stationery. Wataru bought the same items with his own money, repeatedly.
evidence.kenta_sighting.name: Kenta's Sighting
evidence.kenta_sighting.desc: Kenta saw a uniformed figure walking from the east entrance. The time is uncertain.
evidence.matsutani_report.name: Matsutani's Report
evidence.matsutani_report.desc: The liquor shop's damage report. The stated amount is larger than the truth.
evidence.goda_statement.name: Goda's Statement
evidence.goda_statement.desc: Goda said: 'A minor's scandal should be settled inside the neighborhood.'
evidence.past_settlement.name: Past Settlements
evidence.past_settlement.desc: Two previous shoplifting cases settled internally. Neither was reported.
evidence.goda_memo.name: Goda's Memo
evidence.goda_memo.desc: A memo by the telephone. Only four words: 'Keep it out of the paper.'
testimony.goda.01.text: The boy goes to cram school every day. He studies at home at night.
testimony.goda.02.text: At the time of the thefts he was at cram school. We pick him up and drop him off.
testimony.goda.02.askBack: What time do you pick him up?
testimony.goda.02.success: The timestamp on the tape overlaps with cram school hours.
testimony.goda.02.fail: That is not a question of time.
testimony.goda.03.text: He must have sold the stolen goods for pocket money. Kids want money.
testimony.goda.03.askBack: Who did he sell them to?
testimony.goda.03.success: The ledger lists stationery, sweets, batteries. Nothing resellable.
testimony.goda.04.text: We never deprived him of anything. He lacks neither money nor things.
testimony.goda.04.askBack: How much pocket money does he get?
testimony.matsutani.01.text: My shop was hit too. They only go for valuables.
testimony.matsutani.01.success: The sake remained. What vanished was sweets and batteries.
testimony.matsutani.02.text: I keep the books, but I never open the safe.
testimony.wataru.02.text: I needed money. I stole it and sold it.
testimony.okada.01.text: Wataru goes to cram school. I walked him there.
testimony.okada.01.askBack: When did you last walk him there?
testimony.okada.02.text: He has no place at home. But he has not done anything wrong.
testimony.okada.02.askBack: What do you mean, no place?
talk.kenta.01.a: That silhouette was Wataru. Same uniform.
talk.kenta.01.b: But I'm not sure about the time. Seven? Seven-thirty?
talk.matsutani.01.a: Sweets and batteries. Not much money.
talk.matsutani.01.b: Still, it's not something I can keep quiet about.
talk.chiaki.01.a: The security camera from last year is still running. Want to see the tape?
talk.chiaki.01.b: You only see his back, but the timestamp is exact.
talk.goda.01.a: Settling it inside is the polite thing. No need for the police.
inspect.ledger: The ledger by the register. Dates and items in small handwriting.
inspect.notebook: A notebook I do not recognize, wedged under the waiting chair.
inspect.slips: A bundle of purchase slips. The same item name appears again and again.
inspect.settlement: Past settlement records. Two cases were never reported.
inspect.memo: A memo by the phone. 'Keep it out of the paper.' Goda's handwriting.
intro.01: The cherry blossoms have fallen. Half the arcade lights are out.
intro.02: An emergency assembly is called. The agenda: shoplifting.
intro.03: Five shops, fourteen cases in three months. No one says the culprit's name yet.
intro.05: On the day of the assembly, the boy came to the shop as always and bought a notebook.
epilogue.01: The assembly ended with no report to the police.
epilogue.02: Goda left without a word. A copy of the memo remained on the desk.
epilogue.03: The boy began helping at the shop.
epilogue.04: No one spoke of that day again.
